name: correctness-non-evicting
description: Correctness experiment, not a performance experiment. Each evicting policy is given a budget LARGER than the whole workload (context 128 + 4 generated tokens = 132 <= capacity 256), so it must never actually evict. Under that condition every policy has to reproduce the full-cache result exactly: same final token count and same quality value. Any difference is a bug in the policy, in the eviction path, or in the accounting -- not a research result. Pass condition: cache_final_tokens AND quality_value both equal the full_cache reference row. Compare rows in the emitted CSV/JSONL; docs/benchmarks.md describes the exact comparison. NOTE: an earlier version of this config used keep_ratio 1.0, which gives a budget of exactly 128 -- smaller than prefill(128) + decode(4) -- so the bounded policies did evict and the token counts legitimately differed. See docs/research.md, Failed Experiments.
